summary: Comprehensive product and engineering implementation plan combining the best capabilities of Runna, TrainerRoad, Garmin Connect, Strava, and Intervals.icu into AeroPulse: (1) Multi-Week Goal-to-Calendar Adaptive Plan Generator with automatic Deload weeks and Calendar Objective Ribbon, (2) Live Race Time Predictor, 350W FTP Trajectory Model, and Runna-style Pace & Power Insights auto-calibration, (3) TrainerRoad-style Energy-System Progression Levels (1.0-10.0) & Garmin Load Focus Tunnels, and (4) Strava-style Matched Runs/Rides longitudinal comparison, Planned vs. Actual Execution Compliance Scoring, and a Seasonal Peak Power & Pace PR Trophy Matrix.
